page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and text processing tests, alongside a bottom 10% result in single-threaded gzip compression. Conversely, multi-core performance is consistently average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks also falls within the average range, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

The instance offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the modest single-core speeds. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for multi-threaded applications, such as static web serving, database operations, and medium-sized LLM inference, which all perform in the average tier. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-threaded performance make it less suitable for sequential processing tasks or high-I/O database workloads requiring local NVMe drives.
